question: Can head-specific pattern or interaction terms compensate the P/C collateral of the target-dominant value terms in a small distributed attention program?
prior_art: The exact homogeneous 3-factor lattice and exact 4-head value-allocation lattice are valid nulls. The latter evaluates global pattern/interaction only, so it cannot detect cancellation by a pattern or interaction term at one head. Existing adaptive module greedy operates on complete heads/modules, not the exact 12 P/V/interaction components.
components: Twelve absolute response factors in frozen order: for L8H1, L9H1, L9H4, and L11H3, pattern_on_base_value, base_pattern_on_value_change, and pattern_value_interaction. Complete attention 15 remains donor-clamped in every scientific arm.

search.target_first_path: Starting at the attention-15-only mask, evaluate every one-component extension at each depth and advance to largest A1 signed projection; ties use direction fraction, fewer P+C flips, lower max P/C median KL, then component order.
search.constrained_path: From the same start, evaluate every one-component extension and advance to minimum normalized eligibility distance d=max(0,.75-A1)/.75 + max(0,.875-direction)/.875 + P_flips + C_flips + 10*max(0,max(P_KL,C_KL)-.02); ties use larger A1 then component order.
search.selection: Among every arm opened by either path, select any A1-eligible arm by fewest components, then largest A1 projection, then numeric mask. Eligibility is A1 projection >=.75, direction >=.875, zero P and C flips separately, and max separate-panel median KL <=.02. A2 never affects either path or selection.
search.scope: The null is path-local, not an exhaustive 4096-mask impossibility statement. All 12 singleton columns are necessarily opened at depth one.

predictions.pred_a_authority_absolute_clamp_factor_c: Authorities and aligned rows match; attention reconstruction, factor closure, base self, and full-mask parent replay are <=1e-4 with categorical equality; all metrics are finite; no more than 178 forwards execute.
predictions.pred_b_dual_greedy_finds_selective_progr: At least one arm visited by the two paths is A1-eligible.
predictions.pred_c_selected_program_confirms_on_a2: The selected arm reaches A2 signed projection >=.75 and direction fraction >=.875 without A2 selection.
predictions.pred_d_selected_allocation_is_head_heter: The selected per-head factor subsets are not identical across all four heads.
predictions.pred_e_selected_program_tracks_parent_re: The selected arm reaches final-residual signed projection >=.25 on A1 and >=.32 on A2.
predictions.pred_f_selected_components_are_necessary: Every selected-component deletion either drops A1 signed projection by >=.05 or makes the arm ineligible. Missing deletion arms are executed after selection within the price cap.

terminal_policy.selective_head_factor_behavior_only: A-D and F pass but E fails.
terminal_policy.head_factor_uniform_or_nonnecessary: A-C pass but D or F fails.
terminal_policy.partial: A passes and no more specific terminal applies.

next_branch: A selective result licenses source-position and QK/OV translation plus fresh construction confirmation. A valid path-local null passes the 12 singleton causal-response columns to the target-feasible, noise/KL-regularized cross-fitted DAS protocol from the 20:26 mathematical review.
